title: Ezra Undercover
description: As part of a daring mission, Ezra Bridger spent a number of weeks training in the Imperial Academy on Lothal, which was a cover for his true purpose: stealing the Empire's decoder. This item contained the location of a powerful kyber crystal, an object that posed a genuine threat to the Rebel Alliance. Ezra succeeded in his mission and the crystal was soon destroyed. But during his stay at the Academy, he befriended other freedom-loving cadets, and eventually helped them escape from Imperial rule.
